description: This file defines the NoteDetailActivity class for an Android application, responsible for displaying detailed information about a note, allowing editing and deletion functionalities.

classes.name: NoteDetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for displaying detailed information about a note, with options to edit or delete the note.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, retrieves the note by ID, and sets up click listeners for editing and deleting.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect current note data when the activity resumes, ensuring displayed information is current.
